title: That Phone Call
description:
A Sunday call.

Dad brought it up out of nowhere.

'Minjun-ah — that time you called because something went well. Your voice sounded good that day.'

The day {name} first crossed ₩50 million, the first call was to Dad.

choices.text: "I was happy. I wanted to hear your voice."
choices.result_text:
'...Yeah. I felt good that day too.'

The first person {name} thought of after making money was Dad. That meant something.
Numbers are cold when looked at alone. Less so when there's someone to share them with.

choices.text: "It wasn't a big deal. I made a fuss over nothing."
choices.result_text:
Dad laughed.
'Fuss or not, it was good. Getting a call when my son has good news.'

That line stayed in {name}'s head for days.

title: The Door You Knocked On
description:
On the day {name} left the goshiwon, they knocked on Hyun-su's door before leaving.

Today a KakaoTalk came from Hyun-su.

'Hyung — when you left, you knocked on my door. I remember that. I was kind of lonely that day.'

choices.text: "Of course I'd say goodbye. How are you?"
choices.result_text:
'Good, thanks to you, hyung.'

One knock on the way out stayed with someone for a long time.
{name} hadn't realized that small goodbye had landed that deeply.

choices.text: "I still think about that room sometimes."
choices.result_text:
'Me too, hyung.'

The narrow hallway, the shared kitchen, the smell of ramen at dawn.
Only after leaving did that era settle into a single scene.

title: The Pause at the End of the Hall
description:
On the day {name} left the goshiwon, they paused at the end of the hallway and thought about the time spent there.

Today, walking somewhere, they passed a hallway of the same narrow width.

That smell, that dim light. Instantly back there.

choices.text: That time made this time — accept it
choices.result_text:
Decided not to be ashamed of that room.

A humble starting point isn't a weakness. Coming from there to here — that's the story.
{name} walked on past the hallway.

choices.text: Vow never to go back there
choices.result_text:
Fear is fuel too.

The memory of that narrow room pushed {name} one more step today.
So as not to go back. That was reason enough.

title: The Vow That Day
description:
The first time {name} went to Gangnam alone, they made a silent vow: 'I'll definitely make it here.'

Today they passed that street again.

A little closer than back then. Not arrived yet, but closer.

choices.text: Renew the vow once more
choices.result_text:
That day's vow wasn't empty.

A vow made only in words is different from one backed by months of accumulated time.
{name} paused on that street, then kept walking.

choices.text: Know a vow isn't enough — audit the actions
choices.result_text:
A vow is a starting line, not a finish.

{name} coldly retraced what had actually been done since that day.
Not by emotion, but by numbers. That was how you keep a vow.

title: Being Honest That Day
description:
The first time {name} went to Gangnam alone, they got honest: 'you don't know if this is really your goal.'

They carried that doubt and still made it this far.

Today the question surfaced again. Found an answer?

choices.text: Now I know — this is my goal
choices.result_text:
Pushing a doubted goal all the way through.

In that process {name} confirmed it was truly theirs.
A goal made stronger precisely because it had been shaken.

choices.text: Still don't always know — but keep going
choices.result_text:
You can walk without certainty.

Decided not to erase the doubt, but to carry it.
Going forward without knowing is its own kind of courage — {name} learned that.

title: The Night I Went Back to the Plan
description:
On the night the weight of ₩3 billion shook {name}, they ended up opening the plan again.

Back to the numbers.

That choice built the current momentum.

choices.text: Plan over emotion — that principle was right
choices.result_text:
The habit of returning to numbers when shaken.

That saved {name} several times.
Emotion is the wave; the plan is the anchor. Dropping anchor that night was right.

choices.text: There were moments the plan alone wasn't enough
choices.result_text:
A plan is direction, not everything.

Some days called for closing the plan and resting.
{name} learned that balance through trial and error.

title: The Night I Just Lay Down
description:
On the night the weight of ₩3 billion pressed down, {name} did nothing and just lay down to sleep.

The doubt of that day.

Tonight a similar night returned.

choices.text: Like that day — sleep first, look again tomorrow
choices.result_text:
Stopping is a strategy too.

{name} now knows that just sleeping that day wasn't running away — it was recovery.
The next morning the numbers were the same, but the person was a little different.

choices.text: Not just lying down this time — do one small thing
choices.result_text:
Remembering that day's helplessness.

Decided to do one tiny thing before sleep today.
Doubt only shrinks through action — {name} knew that after that night.

title: The Call Just to Hear a Voice
description:
The day {name} first crossed ₩100 million, they couldn't tell anyone and called Dad instead. Just to hear his voice.

Today Dad brought up that call again.

'You called out of the blue that time. Asked if everything was okay. Did something happen that day?'

choices.text: "Something good happened — and you were the only one I could tell."
choices.result_text:
Dad went quiet for a while.

'...Yeah. Call anytime.'

More than the number ₩100 million, the fact that Dad was the only one to share it with weighed on {name}.

choices.text: "I just wanted to hear your voice."
choices.result_text:
'...I feel that sometimes too.'

A call with no reason. Both knew that's the hardest kind of call to make.

title: The Can of Beer Alone
description:
The day {name} crossed ₩100 million, they celebrated alone with a can of beer at the convenience store.

Today they achieved something again.

Standing in front of the convenience store fridge once more.

choices.text: Alone again — but it's familiar and comfortable now
choices.result_text:
Celebrating alone had become not loneliness but a private ritual.

Cracked the can, took the first sip, smiled quietly.
There are achievements that count even when no one else knows.

choices.text: This time, reach out to just one person
choices.result_text:
Held the can and opened the phone.

Drinking alone is fine, but sometimes you need someone to drink with.
{name} scrolled through contacts for a while, then sent someone a message.

title: Telling Her Everything
description:
The day {name} decided to tell Dae-un everything — the ₩3 billion goal, starting with ₩500,000, all of it.

Today Dae-un brought it up again.

'When you told me everything that day, honestly I was surprised. But — thank you. You trusted me.'

choices.text: "I didn't want to hide anything from you."
choices.result_text:
Dae-un fiddled with her cup and smiled.

'That's why I wanted to go along. Your reckless goal.'

The choice not to hide set the two of them facing the same direction.

choices.text: "You were the only one I had who'd believe it."
choices.result_text:
'...Then own those words.'

Dae-un said it like a joke, but her eyes were serious.
Being trusted was a weight too. {name} didn't mind that weight.

title: When I Opened Up
description:
When Sangchul shared his own beginning, {name} had related: 'I started from a similar place.'

Today Sangchul mentioned it again.

'You told me about yourself that time. That's when I started seeing you differently.'

choices.text: "I meant it."
choices.result_text:
Sangchul nodded.

'I know you don't say things like that lightly. That's why I trust you more.'

Approaching with sincerity rather than calculation had changed the grain of the relationship.

choices.text: "Honestly, I regretted saying it. Thought maybe I was too open."
choices.result_text:
Sangchul laughed.

'You think honesty's a weakness? In this business it's the rarest weapon there is.'

{name} chewed on that for a long time.

title: Picking Up the Plan Again
description:
The day after being scammed by Jaehyuk, {name} didn't collapse — they opened the plan again.

That recovery built the current momentum.

Today that day suddenly came to mind.

choices.text: Getting back up that day was the best choice
choices.result_text:
It's not the scam that makes a person — it's what they do the next day.

On a day {name} could have stayed down, they opened the plan.
That single page carried all the way here.

choices.text: That loss still surfaces sometimes — but I learned
choices.result_text:
The money never came back.

But {name} gained an eye for people, a habit of doubt, a way to get back up.
An expensive lesson — but not one {name} entirely regretted paying for.

title: Looking Up at That Apartment Again
description:
Entering the final stretch, {name} looked up at that apartment again.

Today they stood before it once more.

Closer than that time. Almost within reach.

choices.text: Picture the day I look up from inside
choices.result_text:
The building looked up at from outside will one day be looked down from within.

That image had shifted from a vague dream to a concrete plan.
{name} ran the numbers again. Not far now.

choices.text: Don't rush — stay calm to the end
choices.result_text:
People stumble most when the finish line is in sight.

{name} deliberately slowed their breathing.
The same way that got them here — that's how the end would go too.

title: The Place I Bookmarked
description:
The day {name} crossed ₩2.5 billion, they bookmarked a ₩1.7 billion listing. 'This is the goal.'

Today they opened that listing again.

Still not sold. As if it were waiting.

choices.text: Run the final calculation toward that place
choices.result_text:
Not a vague 'Gangnam,' but one specific home.

When a goal has coordinates, the path gets clear.
{name} measured the remaining distance against that home.

choices.text: The home is just a means — reconsider the real goal
choices.result_text:
That home is a symbol, not the essence.

What {name} truly wanted — a life no longer chased, a self with nothing left to prove.
Closing the listing photo, {name} looked past it.
